episodeTitle.en: Category creation and brand building | Barbra Gago (Pando, Miro, Greenhouse, Culture Amp)
episodeTitle.zh: 类别创造与品牌建设 | 芭芭拉·加戈（Barbra Gago，Pando、Miro、Greenhouse、Culture Amp）

guestBioOfficial.en: Barbra Gago is the founder and CEO of Pando, where she’s democratizing career progression. Previously she worked as the Chief Marketing Officer and Global Head of Marketing at Miro, where she helped create an entirely new software category for the space, and also served as VP of Marketing at Greenhouse, where she led go-to-market strategy. In today’s episode, we cover three main topics: category creation, branding and rebranding, and building opinionated software. Barbra discusses how she was able to rebrand Miro and launch a whole new category—and why her attempt to do that at Greenhouse failed. We cover the benefits of building your own category, and when it makes sense to do so and when it doesn’t. She also shares the importance of getting to know your users, why a great brand is informed by its values, and why Pando is built in an opinionated way.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 芭芭拉·加戈（Barbra Gago）是Pando的创始人兼CEO，她正在推动职业发展民主化。此前，她曾在Miro担任首席营销官和全球营销主管，为该领域创造了一个全新的软件类别，还在Greenhouse担任营销副总裁，负责市场推广策略。在本期节目中，我们将围绕三个主要话题展开讨论：类别创造、品牌与品牌重塑，以及构建有态度的软件。芭芭拉将讲述她如何成功重塑Miro品牌并开创全新类别，以及为何她在Greenhouse的尝试以失败告终。我们还将探讨创建自己的类别的好处，以及何时适合这样做，何时不适合。她还将分享了解用户的重要性，伟大品牌如何由其价值观驱动，以及Pando为何以有态度的方式构建。

title.en: Category creation and brand building | Barbra Gago (Pando, Miro, Greenhouse, Culture Amp)
title.zh: 类别创造与品牌建设 | 芭芭拉·加戈（Barbra Gago，Pando、Miro、Greenhouse、Culture Amp）

summary.en: Barbra explains category creation—how she rebranded Miro and launched the “visual collaboration” category, and why a similar attempt at Greenhouse failed. She shares why a great brand is informed by its values and why Pando is built as opinionated software for career growth. The conversation covers branding, rebranding, and the strategic decision of when (and when not) to create your own category.
summary.zh: Barbra 讲解了品类创造——她如何重塑 Miro 品牌并推出“可视化协作”品类，以及在 Greenhouse 类似尝试为何失败。她分享了为何优秀品牌由其价值观塑造，以及 Pando 为何作为“有主张的”软件来构建职业发展。对话涵盖品牌、品牌重塑，以及何时（不该）自创品类的战略决策。
